findings.description: Arguments that are hidden or deprecated are not filtered out. The new code includes every Argument in the help listing, and it uses a fallback record built from make_metavar for any argument without help.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with one documented argument and another argument that is hidden or intentionally undocumented. Mechanism: the old code only listed arguments whose get_help_record returned a record. The new code builds a fallback record for every argument lacking help and writes it. Impact: the help output changes and may expose arguments the author did not intend to show. This is a deliberate behavior change per the docstring, and Argument does not support hidden, so confidence is low.
